units: Ḥall. II, 6 וסִיאוּרָן Ar. (ed. ושאורן) the leaven required for them.—Trnsf. original immoral condition; evil nature.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 2:2:13">Y. Ab. Zar. II, 41ᵃ</cite> top <he>חזר לסִיאוּרוֹ</he> he returned to his old condition (heathenism).

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:8:1">Koh. R. to VII, 8</cite> <he>אילולי כן חזר הפרסי לסיאורו</he> because but for it (Samuel’s forbearance) that Persian would have gone back to heathenism; a. e.—V. <cite ref="O00412"><he>סוֹר</he></cite>.
